identification: Framed hand-coloured steel engraving 'Victoria, or Port Phillip' by John Tallis (engraved J. Rapkin), London c1851, image about 10x14 in, in a birdseye maple style frame with green mount, Lahaina Printsellers (Hawaii) certificate of authenticity. Genuine Tallis Illustrated Atlas plate looks right; the Tallis maps were printed in large numbers so they are common decorative Australiana.

viewing_check: Check the print is not a later reproduction (steel-plate line crispness, plate mark, paper age, hand-colour not printed dots under a loupe), toning or foxing and any mount burn; check the frame is genuine birdseye maple veneer and sound; photograph the maker line at bottom of map and the Tallis/Rapkin imprint. Frame size about 70x60cm may be worth a few tens of dollars by itself.
